# Manifest writer fixtures (Plan 4C answer key)

Written 2026-11-08 by an agent separate from the writer's author; the code's author may not edit them. Synthetic issuers (Northwind, Harbor Lane) are fictional.
- `synthetic/` (`synthetic-hy-001`): high-yield private-side run; context is a byte copy of `../synthetic/`; CP-1 is no longer one (R-26: Period cells are `<kind> ended <date>`; the cover table is oldest-first; the delivered `CP-1.md` has the same bytes as `CP-1.md`); receipt, one delivery folder (with `view.json` listed in `delivery.json`), all checklist items done; its two non-context workflow sources are cited as `wf_source_0` and `wf_source_1` (Q5).
- `retained/` (`web-04cd...`, TDG FY2024): retained model output (inputs never edited; the key records what the R-26 rule gives on them as written: leverage and cover Period cells are off-format, so no leverage, net leverage or coverage metric, no `cp1_leverage` or `cp1_coverage` source and the gap `CP-1 chart periods are not in the fixed format`; liquidity is in format, so cash and undrawn stay); only `expectations.json` is hand-written, its five non-context workflow sources are `wf_source_0` to `wf_source_4` (the `context` entry is not cited, Q5), `copy.json` lists the byte-for-byte copies from `runs/` (the `inputs/ec0a...` file becomes `context.json`) the test must make into a temp workspace first.
- `edge/` (`synthetic-edge-001`): interim `h1-2025`; LTM row chosen over an `H1 2025` row on the same date, `Not supplied` net leverage, two cover rows with the same `LTM ended` date (no metric, no older fallback), `1,250` cash with a negative undrawn (no metric), empty-id deal term not shown (the run gains the blank-id gap, Q4) and empty rating skipped, the blank-currency `TL-A` size has unit `m` alone (Q6), quote on a facility with no deal term, no receipt, no delivery; CP-1A is requested but has no handoff (item not done).
- `missing-expectations/`: no `expectations.json`; `expected-error.txt` holds `expectations.json`, which the `ManifestError` message must name.
- Compare `expected-library.json` as parsed JSON (key order is the spec's order but not binding); sources are compared in full, including the quote's leading spaces and trailing commas.
- `workspace/` is the workspace root. Every sha256, line and quote was computed from the final bytes and checked by a throwaway script.
- `run.issuer` is always `identity.issuer_id` (R-25; `tdg` for retained). Choices where the spec is silent: the line of a `delivery.json` or receipt hash is the whole line with its indentation; `receipt_report` and delivery evidence order follows the checklist; the chosen delivery's report hash is the `delivery.json` value (it equals the file's real hash in every case).
- `selection-cases.json`: the R-26 row-selection, format, header and number cases (CP-1 chart-table text as lines, plus the hand-written expected metrics, `cp1_*` sources, gaps and discovery admission) that `tests/test_library_manifest.py::test_selection_case_gives_the_hand_written_answers` reads. Hand-written; the writer's implementer may not edit it. Written 2026-11-10 by key-writers separate from the writer's implementer; moved verbatim from the test module.
- `facility-source-cases.json`: Q4-Q6 cases (duplicate and blank facility ids, gap order, which workflow sources `wf_source_<n>` cites) that `tests/test_library_manifest.py::test_facility_and_source_case_gives_the_hand_written_answers` reads. Each case rewrites the `synthetic` run's `deal_terms`/`quotes` (blank keys filled in the form's order, so pin lines are counted by hand: a deal row is 18 lines from line 28, a quote row 11 lines) and/or the lines of `workflow.json`'s `sources` object (from line 15), and states the expected facilities, gaps, pins (line and quote) and `sources` requirement; the hashes are those of the files the test writes. Hand-written 2026-11-10; the writer's implementer may not edit it.
- `primary/` (`synthetic-primary-001`, Lantern Freight, fictional): `run_type: primary`, CP-1 (leverage and net leverage) and CP-2 requested and present; CP-2's `Pro forma leverage` table has the excluding row `Not supplied` and `As marketed` 4.25, so the key holds `leverage_as_marketed` beside the CP-1 metrics and no `leverage_pro_forma`. Context has no deal terms, quotes or ratings; no receipt, no delivery, no workflow sources.
- `pro-forma-cases.json`: table-driven pro forma leverage cases (`cp2` lines, context `run_type`, expected metrics and pins) that `tests/test_library_manifest.py::test_pro_forma_case_gives_the_hand_written_answers` runs on the `primary` workspace; the last case copies lines 87-90 and 123-129 of the retained Mattress Firm 2014-09-11 C2 `CP-2.md` verbatim (one issuer/date, older source, read-only path in the plan-4 contract). Hand-written 2026-11-10; the writer's implementer may not edit it.
